name: budu
description: Budu — a modular, mobile-first, responsive CSS design framework inspired by Bootstrap, Foundation, Tailwind CSS and Material Design. Ships as a Sass/LESS source, compiled CSS, vanilla JS, and an npm package with a CDN-ready build.

scripts.build: npm run css && npm run js
scripts.css: npm run css:main && npm run css:grid && npm run css:reboot && npm run css:utilities && npm run css:anim
scripts.css:main: npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu.scss dist/css/budu.css && npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu.scss dist/css/budu.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:grid: npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-grid.scss dist/css/budu-grid.css && npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-grid.scss dist/css/budu-grid.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:reboot: npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-reboot.scss dist/css/budu-reboot.css && npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-reboot.scss dist/css/budu-reboot.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:utilities: npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-utilities.scss dist/css/budu-utilities.css && npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-utilities.scss dist/css/budu-utilities.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.css:anim: npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-animations.scss dist/css/budu-animations.css && npx --no-install sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=global-builtin,color-functions,slash-div,import,if-function scss/budu-animations.scss dist/css/budu-animations.min.css --style=compressed
